description: Today, Senator Cindy Holscher announced Republicans for Cindy, a coalition of twenty-one current and former Republican elected officials supporting her campaign for governor. Many served alongside both Holscher and Masterson and saw firsthand how she worked across party lines to deliver for Kansas families. Throughout her time in the legislature, Holscher has brought Republicans, Independents, and Democrats together around practical and pragmatic solutions. That record began in her first term in the Kansas House, when she co-founded a bipartisan coalition that ended the Brownback tax experiment and restored stability to the state budget.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Cindy Holscher for Kansas
title: Holscher Campaign Launches “Republicans For Cindy” | Cindy Holscher for Governor
